what: An August run, re-expressed in the lab's shape. Kronos's forecasts were frozen at the time and are read unchanged. The baselines were derived afterwards from bars ending at the basis session — arithmetic that could not have been tuned, but computed after the fact, and every baseline block says so with `frozen: false`.
